Leviticus 18:1: And Shema spoke to Mushi, saying:
Leviticus 18:2: “Speak to the children of Yishraʾel, and say to them, ‘I am Shema your God.

Leviticus 18:4: My ordinances you shall follow and my statutes you shall keep and walk in them. I am Shema your God.
Leviticus 18:5: You shall therefore keep my statutes and my ordinances, which if a man does, he shall live in them. I am Shema.
Leviticus 18:6: None of you shall approach anyone who is near of kin to him to uncover their nakedness. I am Shema.
Leviticus 18:7: The nakedness of your father or the nakedness of your mother you shall not uncover; she is your mother, you shall not uncover her nakedness.
Leviticus 18:8: The nakedness of your father’s wife you shall not uncover; it is your father’s nakedness.
